description.para: Choices for output selections for the device, used in XWdtPs_EnableOutput()/XWdtPs_DisableOutput() functions.
Control value setting flags, used in XWdtPs_SetControlValue()/XWdtPs_GetControlValue() functions.

briefdescription.para: Checks if the watchdog timer has expired.

detaileddescription.para: Use this macro in polled mode. It also checks if the watchdog timer caused the last reset.

listitem.para: TRUE if the watchdog has expired.
FALSE if the watchdog has not expired.

detaileddescription.para: An application must call this macro periodically to keep the timer from asserting the enabled output.

briefdescription.para: Looks up the device configuration based on the device ID/BaseAddress.

detaileddescription.para: The XWdtPs_ConfigTable[] contains the configuration info for each device in the system.

simplesect.para: A pointer to the configuration found or NULL if the specified device ID/BaseAddress was not found. See xwdtps.h for the definition of XWdtPs_Config.
In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.

briefdescription.para: Initializes a specific watchdog timer instance/driver.

detaileddescription.para: Call this function before calling any other function of the driver.

parameterdescription.para: Base address for the device. It could be a virtual address if address translation is supported in the system, otherwise it is the physical address.

listitem.para: XST_DEVICE_IS_STARTED if the device has already been started.

briefdescription.para: Starts the watchdog timer of the device.

detaileddescription.para: It is the caller's responsibility to disconnect the interrupt handler of the watchdog timer from the interrupt source, typically an interrupt controller, and disable the interrupt in the interrupt controller.
Performs a read/modify/write cycle to update the value correctly.

parameterdescription.para: Desired signal/output. Valid Signal Values are XWDTPS_RESET_SIGNAL and XWDTPS_IRQ_SIGNAL. Only one of them can be specified at a time.

detaileddescription.para: Performs a read/modify/write cycle to update the value correctly.

parameterdescription.para: Desired signal/output. Valid Signal Values are XWDTPS_RESET_SIGNAL and XWDTPS_IRQ_SIGNAL. Only one of them can be specified at a time.

briefdescription.para: Returns the current control setting for the indicated signal/output.

detaileddescription.para: The register referenced is the Counter Control Register (XWDTPS_CCR_OFFSET).

parameterdescription.para: Desired signal/output. Valid Control Values are XWDTPS_CLK_PRESCALE and XWDTPS_COUNTER_RESET. Only one of them can be specified at a time.

simplesect.para: The contents of the requested control field in the Counter Control Register (XWDTPS_CCR_OFFSET). If the Control is XWDTPS_CLK_PRESCALE then use the definitions XWDTPS_CCR_PSCALE_XXXX. If the Control is XWDTPS_COUNTER_RESET then the values are 0x0 to 0xFFF. This is the Counter Restart value in the CCR register.

briefdescription.para: Updates the control setting for the indicated signal/output.

detaileddescription.para: Updates the current control setting for the indicated signal/output with the provided value.
Performs a read/modify/write cycle to update the value correctly. The register referenced is the Counter Control Register (XWDTPS_CCR_OFFSET).

parameterdescription.para: Desired signal/output. Valid Control Values are XWDTPS_CLK_PRESCALE and XWDTPS_COUNTER_RESET. Only one of them can be specified at a time.

Desired control value. If the Control is XWDTPS_CLK_PRESCALE then use the definitions XWDTPS_CCR_PSCALE_XXXX. If the Control is XWDTPS_COUNTER_RESET then the valid values are 0x0 to 0xFFF. This sets the counter restart value of the CCR register.

briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the timebase.

detaileddescription.para: This test verifies that the register access locking functions. The test tries to alter a register without setting the key value and verifies that the register contents did not change.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if self-test was not successful.
